title: 第169章 真正实力第168章 七连胜的狂战队
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
战场核心，唐三双目微凝，紫极魔瞳全力运转，将敌方所有人的魂力流转、破绽走位、发力节奏尽收眼底，玄天功内力平稳流转周身，时刻掌控全场战局节奏。
他的目标，从始至终都是对方两大核心——蜘蛛女、如意盘魂师！
“蓝银草，缠绕！”
第一魂技瞬间发动！
地面之下，无数坚韧的蓝银藤蔓破土而出，如毒蛇游走，精准朝着人面魔蛛蜘蛛女与后方的如意盘辅助魂师缠绕而去，试图第一时间锁死对方双核。
蜘蛛女眼神一凛，粉色长发骤然狂舞！
“第一魂技：蛛腿缠绕！”
八道粉色蛛丝瞬间暴涨延长，精准迎击蓝银藤蔓，两种束缚魂力在空中死死僵持、互相制衡，一时难分胜负。
就在这僵持时刻，后排金光骤然洒落！
宁荣荣七宝琉璃塔悬浮半空，清脆声响响彻擂台：“七宝有名，一曰力！二曰速！”
七彩琉璃光芒瞬间笼罩史莱克全员，力量、速度同步增幅百分之三十！
增幅加持瞬间，唐三蓝银草韧性、爆发力暴涨数倍！
“第二魂技：寄生！”
潜藏在蓝银藤蔓中的种子瞬间爆发，无数细密藤条顺着对方蛛丝反向蔓延，直接穿透蛛丝防御，瞬间缠上蜘蛛女的双臂！
藤蔓扎根肌肤，丝丝魂力侵入经脉，蜘蛛女只觉得手臂一阵发麻，周身魂力运转瞬间滞涩受阻，控制能力直接被打断！
战局优势，瞬间倒向史莱克一方。
可就在这时，后方的如意盘魂师双眼骤然红光暴涨！
他深知战局危急，若是再被唐三持续锁控，狂战队必将步步溃败。
只见他双手快速结印，全身魂力疯狂涌动！
“第三魂技：狂热！”

淡粉色的诡异光芒瞬间铺展全场，尽数笼罩狂战队八人！
下一秒，剧变陡生！
狂犀双目瞬间赤红，肌肉再度暴涨，周身魂力狂暴飙升；
双猴子魂师速度骤然翻倍，挣脱牵制，气息暴戾失控；
羊魂师攻势暴涨，高温魂力疯狂肆虐；
就连被寄生束缚的蜘蛛女，精神力、魂力也瞬间疯狂增幅！
狂热状态彻底开启！
全员攻击、速度增幅百分之五十，彻底失去痛觉，陷入狂暴血战姿态，持续整整三分钟！
但是——
与此同时，宁苒苒见他们终于露出底牌，于是开始展露自己的真正实力。
就在如意盘即将催动狂热增幅的前一瞬，全场空气骤然一凝！
擂台中央，始终低调待命的宁苒苒，终于不再收敛气息。
嗡——！
空灵浩荡的武魂轰鸣震彻全场，压过所有打斗巨响！
巨大的鸾鸟虚影在她身后缓缓展开，九天玄鸾武魂出现！
通体冰蓝剔透，水晶翎羽层层舒展，细碎冰晶环绕飞舞，尾羽银纹流光熠熠，羽翼扇动之间，七彩光晕洒落，圣洁又威严的神性威压瞬间铺满整座擂台。
没有实体降临，仅仅一道虚影，便压得全场魂力为之滞涩！
紧接着，三道漆黑深邃、厚重古老的万年魂环，自她脚下缓缓升腾、上下律动！
三环三黑，全员万年顶配魂环！
content_en:
At the core of the battlefield, Tang San's eyes were slightly focused, and the Purple Demon Eyes were operating at full strength. He could see the flow of soul power, weak positions, and force rhythm of everyone on the enemy. The internal force of Xuantian Gong flowed smoothly around him, controlling the rhythm of the entire battle at all times.
His targets from beginning to end have been the opponent's two cores - Spider Woman and Ruyi Panhun Master!
"Blue silver grass, entangled!"
The first soul skill is activated instantly!
Under the ground, countless tough blue-silver vines burst out of the ground, swimming like poisonous snakes, precisely heading towards the human-faced demon spider Spider Woman and the Ruyi Pan auxiliary soul master behind, trying to lock the opponent's dual cores at the first opportunity.
Spider Woman's eyes flashed, and her long pink hair suddenly danced wildly!
"The first soul skill: Spider Leg Wrapping!"
The eight pink spider threads instantly expanded and extended, accurately attacking the blue and silver vines. The two bound soul powers were locked in a stalemate in the air, balancing each other. It was difficult to tell the winner for a moment.
At this moment of stalemate, golden light suddenly fell from the back row!
Ning Rongrong's Seven Treasures Glazed Pagoda was suspended in mid-air, and a crisp sound resounded throughout the arena: "The Seven Treasures are famous, one is strength! The other is speed!"
The colorful glazed light instantly enveloped all Shrek members, and their strength and speed simultaneously increased by 30%!
At the moment of the boost, Tang San's Blue Silver Grass's toughness and explosive power surged several times!
"Second Soul Skill: Parasitism!"
The seeds hidden in the blue and silver vines exploded instantly, and countless fine vines spread along the opponent's spider silk, directly penetrated the spider silk defense, and instantly wrapped around Spider Woman's arms!
The vines took root in the skin, and traces of soul power invaded the meridians. The spider woman felt a numbness in her arms, and the movement of soul power throughout her body was instantly blocked, and her control ability was directly interrupted!
The advantage of the battle situation instantly fell to Shrek's side.
But at this moment, the eyes of Ruyi Panhun Master behind him suddenly turned red!
He knew full well that the battle situation was critical. If Tang San continued to control them, Team Madness would be defeated step by step.
I saw him quickly forming seals with his hands, and his soul power surged crazily throughout his body!
"The third soul skill: Fanatical!"
The strange pale pink light instantly spread across the entire venue, covering all eight members of the Mad Sentai team!
The next second, drastic changes occurred!
Crazy Rhino's eyes instantly turned red, his muscles swelled again, and his whole body's soul power soared wildly;
The speed of the two monkey soul masters suddenly doubled, they broke free from the restraint, and their aura became violent and out of control;
The Sheep Soul Master's offensive surged, and the high-temperature soul power raged crazily;
Even Spider Woman, who was bound by the parasite, had a crazy increase in mental and soul power in an instant!
The frenzy is fully on!
The attack and speed of all members increased by 50%, they completely lost their sense of pain, and fell into a violent bloody battle posture, which lasted for three full minutes!
But——
At the same time, Ning Ranran saw that they finally showed their trump card, so she began to show her true strength.
Just before the wishful thinking disk was about to trigger a fanatical increase, the air in the whole room suddenly condensed!
In the center of the ring, Ning Ranran, who had always been keeping a low profile, finally stopped holding back.
Buzz—!
The ethereal and majestic roar of martial arts shook the entire audience, overwhelming all the loud noises of the fight!
The huge phantom of the Luan Bird slowly unfolded behind her, and the Nine Heavens Xuan Luan Martial Spirit appeared!
The whole body is ice blue and clear, the crystal feathers are stretched out layer by layer, fine ice crystals are flying around, the silver streaks of the tail feathers are shining, and when the wings are flapping, the colorful halo is scattered, and the holy and majestic divine pressure instantly fills the entire arena.
No entity came, just a shadow, which suppressed the soul power of the entire audience!
Immediately afterwards, three dark, deep, thick, and ancient ten thousand year soul rings slowly rose from her feet and moved up and down!
Three rings and three blacks, all members will be equipped with soul rings for ten thousand years!
